jjheals2013: On Day 9, Henrik Jjheals arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Henrik Jjheals stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
landonbuttvampire: Day 9. The corporal put Bram Landonbuttva beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Bram Landonbuttva did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Bram Landonbuttva fired back. Wendel "Whistle" Gonzo was grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Bram Landonbuttva stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
merazzmu_s: After 9 days of war, R-C4 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-C4. Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu has learned to walk bent double.
sam_bowles_: They issued Otto Bowles a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a frozen apple in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Otto Bowles wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
thesenorfry: "You're late," said the corporal when Yann Thesenorfry arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into T-F17. Yann Thesenorfry has learned to walk bent double.
tobiasweighill: Henrik Tobiasweighi joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Henrik Tobiasweighi wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
